objective: Computation and exact checks. Hubs: one opened handle relayed into several grids at once. Direction: no creation upstream in any network. Bypasses: stations whose two cut vertices are adjacent relay without loss, as the second cut returns an edge to the previous piece. Exact creation (join method) on small networks: a hub with two receivers, an aligned chain three cuts deep, and a two-cut relay.
status: Proved by RELAY-NET-20261104-001B-P001 (computation; exact on three small networks): a hub receiving an opened handle's relay copies it into several receivers at once; no relay creates upstream of the handle's piece in chains of strips, cubes, grids and thick tubes; stations with adjacent cut vertices are bypassed without loss; exact creation confirms a broadcast, a three-cut chain and a two-cut relay
title: Broadcast, depth and bypasses
